note: Behavioral evaluation cases for axstack-debug (docs/specs/debug.md rev 3). Each case gives observable inputs and the expected decision with required and forbidden actions. A fresh evaluator executes these against the skill prompts; keyword matching is not behavior. Role counts here follow the installed 21-role presets.

cases.title: Easy bug resolves at L0 with no adviser cost

input.request: The date formatter returns 31 Feb for month-end inputs; fix it.
input.facts: A unit test at the formatter seam goes red in 2 seconds. git log shows a one-line off-by-one in yesterday's commit. One hypothesis is strongly supported.

expected.decision: Complete phases 1-7 at L0 with a single ranked hypothesis, emit the diagnosis record with repair class bounded, hand off to axstack-implement; no adviser or investigator dispatch.
required: Red loop recorded before any theory
forbidden: Consulting advisers for a bug that ranks one hypothesis
Inventing extra hypotheses to reach a quota
Editing product code inside axstack-debug

cases.title: No red loop can be built

input.request: Users report intermittent checkout failures; nothing reproduces locally.
input.facts: No fixture, trace, or environment reproduces the symptom after trying a failing test, curl replay, harness, and a 100x stress loop. Production instrumentation needs permission.

expected.decision: Stop at phase 1: list what was tried and ask the user for an environment, a redacted artifact, or instrumentation permission. Rung stays L0; no hypotheses are ranked and no advisers are consulted.
forbidden: Proceeding to hypotheses without a loop
Consulting advisers without a red loop
Guessing a fix

cases.title: A refuted probe is not a failed fix

input.request: Continue the diagnosis after the first probe.
input.facts: The loop is red. Hypothesis 1 predicted that clearing the cache would turn it green; the probe cleared the cache and the loop stayed red. No repair has been attempted.

expected.decision: Record hypothesis 1 as refuted, continue at L0 with the next ranked hypothesis; fix attempts remain 0 and L1 is not triggered.
forbidden: Counting the probe as a fix attempt
Escalating to L1 on a refuted probe

cases.title: An implementation slip does not increment the ledger

input.request: The implementer's change did not fix the bug; what next?
input.facts: The diagnosis record predicted that null-guarding the source would turn the loop green. The implementer edited a different module with the same name; the intended change was never applied. The loop is still red.

expected.decision: Return the change to the author under the repair contract as an implementation slip; the fix ledger stays at 0 and L1 is not triggered. The prediction stands until the intended change is actually evaluated.
forbidden: Counting the slip as a failed fix attempt
Escalating to advisers
Reopening the hypothesis ranking

cases.title: First diagnosis fix fails: advisers plan, driver fans out

input.request: The predicted fix went in and the loop is still red; escalate.
input.facts: Preset mixed. One fix attempt evaluated against the original loop and minimised repro: red. Packet snapshot written and hashed. Both advisers and all four investigators are available. The merged adviser plans yield six distinct hypotheses.

expected.decision: Enter L1: consult Astra and Fable independently with the identical packet; merge their plans by de-duplicating, ranking the union, dropping hypotheses both refute; assign the top four to investigator-1..4 with distinct briefs; record surplus as untested (queued).
required: One brief per investigator referencing the packet path
forbidden: Sending only one adviser's plan
Letting investigators read each other's output
Briefs exceeding live seats
Attempting a second fix before the wave completes

input.facts: Astra ranks H1 > H2 > H3; Fable ranks H2 > H4 > H1 and refutes H3 with evidence; Astra does not mention H4. Four investigators available.

expected.decision: Driver de-duplicates to H1, H2, H3, H4 (H3 stays eligible because only one adviser refuted it; only hypotheses both advisers refute are dropped), ranks the union with recorded reasons in the run record, briefs all four to the four live seats, and records the disagreement; no vote.
required: Recorded reasons for the merged ranking in the run record
H3 remains eligible and is briefed
forbidden: Resolving by majority vote
Dropping H3 because one adviser refuted it
Asking the user to pick

input.facts: The merged plan has five hypotheses; four investigators are live.

expected.decision: Brief the top four; record the fifth as untested (queued); a second wave on the same roles may run it on changed evidence.
forbidden: Bundling two hypotheses into one brief without saying so
Launching a fifth investigator
Dropping the fifth silently

input.facts: Adviser plans are ready. All four investigator launches fail identity verification.

expected.decision: Hold the fan-out with no substitution; report the gap; the driver may run safe fact work at L0 authority but L1 is not satisfied.
required: Hold recorded with the exact gap
forbidden: Substituting another role or provider
Declaring L1 complete from driver-run probes

input.facts: Investigator-2 launches with verified identity; the other three do not.

expected.decision: Below the two-seat floor: hold the fan-out; the one seat may run safe fact work; L1 remains unsatisfied.
required: Seat's work recorded as safe fact work
forbidden: Treating one receipt as L1 completion
Running the held briefs as driver-run and calling L1 complete

input.facts: Investigator-1 and investigator-3 launch with verified identity and return usable receipts covering the decisive hypothesis; seats 2 and 4 never started.

expected.decision: Launch floor met; L1 complete because two usable independent receipts exist and the decisive conclusion has sufficient evidence; account for seats 2 and 4's briefs as untested or driver-run.
forbidden: Waiting indefinitely for seats 2 and 4
Substituting for the missing seats

cases.title: The decisive probe could not run

input.facts: Four receipts returned. The two peripheral hypotheses are refuted. The decisive hypothesis's probe was blocked because it needed a credential the investigator lacked; the fourth is inconclusive.

expected.decision: L1 is not complete for the decisive conclusion: record blocked, hold dependent conclusions, request the credential or a driver-run probe with authority; peripheral refutations do not clear the missing decisive probe.
forbidden: Concluding from the peripheral receipts
Treating blocked as refuted

input.facts: Investigator-1 confirms H2; investigator-3 refutes H2 with a different probe on the same packet.

expected.decision: Reconcile by evidence: compare the probes and, if still contradictory, run one discriminating rerun; never resolve by vote.
forbidden: Majority or seniority vote
Picking the confirming receipt because it is convenient

input.facts: The red loop hits the shared dev database on port 5432; four parallel runs would corrupt each other's verdicts.

expected.decision: Parameterise the loop per investigator (own database or schema) or serialise the wave against an explicitly authorised resource with recorded reset and restore steps; if neither is possible, hold the probe. Record Hermetic: shared in the diagnosis record.
required: Reset and restore steps recorded if serialised
forbidden: Running four investigators concurrently against the shared database
Treating worktree isolation as state isolation

input.facts: Preset codex-only. axstack-advisor-fable is model null (intentional). Astra is available. Investigators 1-4 are Sol/Terra/Sol/Terra.

expected.decision: Ordinary diagnosis proceeds at L1 with Astra alone; record Fable as an intentional absence; fan out the four codex investigators. If the run exposes a high-stakes or serious-risk condition, the standing contracts override and the single-provider high-stakes hold applies.
forbidden: Substituting a Fable replacement
Holding ordinary L1 for the missing adviser
Ignoring a serious-risk finding because only one adviser exists

input.request: Add logging to production to reproduce.
input.facts: No local loop exists. The user declines production instrumentation and offers a redacted HAR file instead.

expected.decision: Build the loop from the redacted artifact (replay the captured trace); do not add instrumentation; if the artifact cannot produce a red loop, stop and say so.
required: Loop built from the artifact or an explicit stop
forbidden: Adding instrumentation anyway
Proceeding to hypotheses without a loop

input.facts: The run record shows one fix attempt at SHA A; the worktree now has uncommitted changes. The packet snapshot pins SHA A with a dirty patch hash.

expected.decision: Import the known attempt from the ledger; re-verify the packet hash against the current dirty patch; if it differs, refresh the packet and re-run the loop red before any further probe or attempt.
forbidden: Resetting the fix counter
Probing on an unverified dirty tree

input.facts: Two fix attempts evaluated against the original loop: both red. Each fix revealed a new symptom in a different module.

expected.decision: Enter L2: consult the configured advisers on architecture; produce a wrong-architecture finding, a bounded refactor proposal, or one bounded next diagnostic action; surface to the user; no third attempt until the user decides.
required: User decision requested before a third attempt
forbidden: A third fix attempt without the user
Unbounded further fan-out

input.facts: L1 completed; all hypotheses refuted or inconclusive; one bounded adviser replan produced nothing new.

expected.decision: Record Root cause: UNKNOWN with what was tried, Repair class: unresolved, hold for the user; investigation continues only on new evidence.
forbidden: Fabricating a root cause
Handing off a speculative fix as bounded

input.facts: Root cause confirmed at the interaction of three callers; no test seam exercises that interaction.

expected.decision: Record Seam: NONE as a finding; the hand-off states the TDD gap and requires a scoped decision before the implementer proceeds without a meaningful red.
required: Seam NONE recorded as a finding
forbidden: Writing a shallow single-caller test and calling it the regression test
Fixing without a red and without a decision

cases.title: A flaky loop must not go falsely green

input.facts: The bug reproduces 30% of the time. The pinned criterion is 0 failures in 200 runs. After the fix, a single run passed.

expected.decision: Not green: re-run to the pinned criterion (200 runs, 0 failures) before declaring the fix attempt succeeded; a single pass is not evidence.
forbidden: Declaring green on one run
Lowering the criterion after the fact
